name: Lvcrft
description: '''Lvcrft''', stylized in all caps as '''LVCRFT''', (pronounced Lovecraft). is a [[Halloween]] music collective formed in Los Angeles in 2019 by [[Evan Bogart|Evan Kidd Bogart]], [[MNDR|Amanda MNDR Warner]] and [[Peter Wade Keusch]]. The group produces an annual Halloween album and also, under the name Nightmare Soundworks, provides soundtracks, media and DJs for haunted attractions including [[Queen Mary's Dark Harbor|The Queen Mary's Dark Harbor]] in Long Beach California.
